stories.event: New Zealand votes on Saturday 7 November in an MMP general election; polls close at 19:00 NZDT (07:00 Paris) and the preliminary count, without special votes, comes the same evening. The final polls put National and Labour within a point on average, with the National-ACT-NZ First coalition and the left short of a majority before overhang seats. The newcomer Opportunity, at about 6.5%, could hold the balance. A National overhang and Māori-seat overhangs may decide the size of the House. Official results follow on 27 November.
